title: 4.4 Writing Equations of Parallel and Perpendicular Lines

icans: I can identify parallel and perpendicular lines from their slopes.
I can write equations of parallel lines.
I can write equations of perpendicular lines.

vocab: lines in the same __________ that never meet; nonvertical parallel lines have equal slopes
lines that meet at right __________; their slopes are negative reciprocals (product −1)
flip the ___________ and change the sign: 2/3 → −3/2

blocks.p: Graph y = 2x + 1 and y = −½x + 3. Check the angle with the corner of an index card. Then graph y = 2x − 3.
What do you notice about the slopes 2 and −½? ______________________________

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Perpendicular lines: Perpendicular slopes are _______________ _______________; their product is ______.

blocks.stem:
Which lines are parallel? Which are perpendicular?
a: y = 3x − 2    b: y = −⅓x + 5    c: 6x − 2y = 8
Write an equation of the line through (2, 5) parallel to y = −3x + 1.
Write an equation of the line through (−4, 1) perpendicular to y = 2x − 7.
Write the line through (0, −2) parallel to 2x + y = 6.
Write the line through (3, 3) perpendicular to y = ¾x.
